_comment: A run profile for the lab Go2, copied from /home/unitree/run-smoke.sh, which is the
invocation that is known to work on that robot. Pass it with:
python3 robot_driver.py --platform go2 --run-profile run-profile.example.json ...
EDIT BEFORE USE. Every path here is a path on THAT robot, and every one of them is a
thing this dashboard cannot verify from the outside.
launch_prefix must authenticate WITHOUT a password. BatchMode=yes makes ssh fail fast
instead of hanging on a prompt nobody can see, which is the behaviour you want when a
run start is waiting on it. Put a key on the robot; a password does not go in this
file, in this repository, or in an issue.
env_setup is what makes `python3` the right interpreter: it prepends the SDK venv to
PATH (cyclonedds exists ONLY in that venv) and exports LD_LIBRARY_PATH, which is what
stops the SDK segfaulting at rc 139 -- this Jetson has two libddsc builds and ldconfig
picks the wrong one. It does NOT set PYTHONPATH, and unitree_sdk2py lives outside
site-packages, so `env` carries that, exported AFTER the source, which is the order
run-smoke.sh uses. A segfault here means the source did not run, not that the venv is
broken -- do not route around the venv.
extra_args carries the deployment's own constants and nothing else. It may not name
--live, --policy-mode, --heading-servo, --no-heading-servo, --max-seconds, --package,
--telemetry or --record: the driver spells those itself from the request, and a second
spelling on one command line is settled by argparse on position. run-smoke.sh passes
--policy-mode supervised and --no-heading-servo; both are deliberately absent here and
the driver sends the explicit equivalents on every run.
heading_servo_flag is 'legacy' because of a measurement, not a preference. On
2026-08-26 this tree's own `mappo_drive.py --help` listed [--no-heading-servo] and no
--heading-servo: it is 67 commits behind #106, which renamed the flag. Sending the new
spelling makes argparse exit 2 on the far end of an SSH connection and the run simply
never starts. Set it back to 'modern' once the tree is refreshed -- and check with its
own --help rather than with this repository's.
label: lab Go2 (berth waypoint)
